kyc.title: Verify your identity
kyc.body: Small bets only need a verified email. Above 1,000 USDT in total deposits, or before withdrawing, you need an ID and a selfie holding it — usually reviewed within 1 business day.
items: ID card (both sides) or passport photo page

deposit.title: Deposit USDT to start
deposit.body: In Assets → Deposit, pick a network, copy your personal address and send USDT from an exchange or wallet.
items: ERC20, TRC20 and BEP20 are supported
Your balance updates automatically and you get a notification
deposit.note: Send USDT only, on the matching network. Wrong transfers can’t be recovered.

what.title: Bet on how things turn out
what.body: Football, NBA, crypto up/down, macro news — pick a question and back the outcome you expect.
items: Each option has its own pool; probability = its share of the total
You can back several options in one market, any time before close
what.note: You can reopen this guide from Me → Getting started.

odds.title: Win a share of the losing pool
odds.body: When the result is in, money on losing options is shared among winners by stake. Odds move with the pool and are fixed at close; the platform only takes 5% of profit.
odds.example:
Bet 100 → about 162.29 back if you win
After fee; 0 if you lose

how.title: How a pari-mutuel pool works
how.s1: Everyone’s stakes go into one pool, split by option. The platform never takes the other side.
how.s2: After the result, the losing options’ money is shared among winners in proportion to their stakes.
how.s3: The platform takes {{rate}}% of winners’ profit only — never of the stake, never from losers.
how.formula: Probability = option pool ÷ total pool; est. payout = 1 + (total ÷ option pool − 1) × (1 − fee)
how.exampleLine: Bet 100 on “{{opt}}” → about {{ret}} back if it wins (after fee); 0 if it loses
how.exampleEmpty: No bets yet. If you bet first and win, you take the whole losing pool (after fee).
how.final: The pool keeps changing until close, when final odds are set. Bets can’t be cancelled; cancelled or voided markets are refunded in full.
